# Four-beat announcement template

Use when a brief needs arrival, news, a product introduction and a close.

1. **Arrival**: the mark enters and keeps moving. No static logo card.
2. **News**: the headline ("We're in.") and the milestone with the
   official mark. The peak: most motion, longest hold.
3. **What we do**: one product line plus an illustrative product
   graphic. Kinetic category words alone are not enough.
4. **Close**: tagline, URL or handle, milestone as a small lockup.
   Background alive to the last frame.

# Milestone reveal

## Celebration

- Secondary motion (a glow swell, rings, a background shift) peaks with the
  land and decays, so the meaning line gets calm.
- Sound: a short riser into the land, one hit on the land, and a light tail.
  Build them with [make-sound](../../make-sound/SKILL.md) or
  a generated bed; the hit is aligned by its transient, not its file start.

---
name: make-announcement-video
description: "Short company news and milestone motion posts without product screens; a launch video from product screenshots or recordings is make-product-demo."
applications:
  - id: remotion
    role: primary
  - id: hyperframes
    role: alternative
  - id: resolve
    role: alternative
  - id: ffmpeg
    role: fallback
voyager:
  schemaVersion: 1
  design: optional
---

A motion post, usually 10–20 seconds: news, sender, what they do, where to go. Build
with [make-motion-graphics](../make-motion-graphics/SKILL.md): for new work, the
user's named tool, then saved motion tool, then defaults; revisions keep their
project's tool.

Bring the [motion-designer mindset](../make-motion-graphics/SKILL.md#design-like-a-motion-designer) to an energetic announcement, with music that lifts the arrival, accents the news and resolves on the close, unless the brief or brand suggests another direction.

For continuous motion, sync or how a clip sounds, use [watch and listen](../make-ai-video/references/understanding.md) (paid upload).

## Official marks on file

`curl -sSL -o public/<file> "<url>"` (signed query string required), verify
the SHA-256, use unmodified. Square mark for motion, wordmark for lockups.

| Mark                                         | File              | URL                                                                                                                                 | SHA-256                                                            |
| -------------------------------------------- | ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Y Combinator square mark, 4555×4555          | `yc-mark.png`     | `https://api.moda.app/api/v2/images/ref/afccdecf-abd5-491b-a58e-bcba3ed7cc69?v=4eb2e668ac14ce60&s=85d5dace8bd17e73247b217d5242148e` | `4eb2e668ac14ce6072dec7ca1e9b9d37fa5fd919535b491f0a898a52ad6edc5d` |
| Y Combinator wordmark, transparent, 3121×890 | `yc-wordmark.png` | `https://api.moda.app/api/v2/images/ref/e1c4ee43-d82b-472c-a878-8a0689037d2b?v=64c8fc1dbc56fe8a&s=9540f5211288de4b0765e4eb4d423232` | `64c8fc1dbc56fe8a0e877ead1144b82c46e545acc240c3c7e16f7e6b60c005d7` |

## Brand kit

Use the project's selected Voyager brand snapshot as
[brand-kit](../brand-kit/SKILL.md) and its [usage](../brand-kit/references/usage.md)
describe. For a company known by its website, `brand/sites/<host>/kit.md` (from
`voyager brand capture example.com`) adds the site's font
files, logos and page copy.

## Structure

Default to news → company/product context → next action. Add a separate logo opening only when it contributes to that message.
The optional [four-beat template](references/four-beat-template.md) supplies one
version with a meaningful arrival beat.

## Milestone

When the news is a number (users, downloads, customers, an anniversary), build
the News beat as the [milestone reveal](references/milestone-reveal.md)
describes. A number celebrated on its own, without the what-we-do and close
beats, is the reveal by itself.

- A reveal that replays loops by reset, built with
  [make-social-loop](../make-social-loop/SKILL.md)'s
  [loop mechanics](../make-social-loop/references/loop-mechanics.md) and its
  seam check.

## Deliverables

One composition with layouts for the requested formats; a 9:16 layout keeps
essential text clear of platform overlays
(`edit-video/references/social-safe-areas.md`).

## Field notes: talking characters

For recurring characters, read [Project Elements](../make-ai-video/SKILL.md#keeping-shots-in-one-world) and pass their element IDs on every generation; a real person's likeness comes only from photos the user supplies.

- Where multi-voice generation is supported, generate one dialogue take, send each line's audio slice to its lip-synced shot, then restore the original full track over the edit to preserve timing and energy.
- Transcribe the final mix against the script to catch dropped words.

## Color And Brand

For any named brand, logo, brand kit or requested brand match, and for color contrast.

- Real brand facts win over inferred treatment. Use the selected snapshot's
  palette, type and supplied logo files, unmodified and in their documented
  variants.

- Exceptions are recorded, not improvised: they live in the brand snapshot's
  `overrides.md` or the active design direction.

- Say what was substituted or unavailable instead of claiming full brand
  fidelity, and name the kit used in the handoff.

### Using a kit

Read the project's brand snapshot (normally `brand/BRAND.md`, with `kit.json`
for tokens and the guides it links) as the `brand-kit` skill describes, and only
the fields the deliverable needs. Work for a website reads its site kit,
`brand/sites/<host>/kit.md`: take colours from `palette.json`, load the faces in
`fonts/` as local fonts, and place logos from `logos/` in the variant `kit.md`
marks transparent.

### Logos and marks

Inspect a logo file before placing it: pick the variant that suits the ground.
Verify a downloaded official mark against its published hash when one is given.
Partner and platform marks are sourced separately and never replace the user's
own brand as the design's identity.

### Color and contrast

A gradient word must stay readable at every stop; on
a dark ground, end on the lightest accent, never on dark purple, navy or black.

### After compression

Judge color in the encoded file, not the composition: faint decoration (glows,
patterns, watermark shapes) can vanish once encoded.

## Locate And Safe Areas

For placing labels, callouts and boxes on real images or moving subjects, and platform safe areas.

- Keep essential text and marks inside the platform's safe area (the `edit-video` skill's `references/social-safe-areas.md` lists them).

### Locate before you annotate

- **Segment it.** `voyager media cutout FRAME --prompt "the red car" --output
  located.png` (SAM 3, metered, about half a cent) keeps every confident match,
  so name exactly one instance ("the left-most car"). Then `voyager media
  crop-alpha located.png --output crop.png --json` reports its `box` (x, y,
  width, height in frame pixels) at no cost.

## Typography

For authoring text or changing fonts, layout or output size.

- Author exact words, numbers and supplied logos as controlled text or overlays;
  inspect the exported file rather than relying on generated imagery to spell.

- Verify the actual renderer has the faces you use; a brand kit's supported-font
  flag is not proof of availability.

- Protect descenders,
  accents and cap height from clipping, including inside masks and line boxes.

- Use the editor integration skill for font loading. For a brand's fonts in Remotion or
  HyperFrames that is the generated brand-fonts helper, not hand-written `@font-face`;
  if it reports a substitute, say so to the user.

- Renderers add no motion blur: fine print and 1–2 px hairlines shimmer in fast moves; keep them out of fast moves or enlarge them.
